Key Concepts in Quality Control for Rubber Gasket Manufacturing

Quality is crucial in rubber gasket manufacturing to avoid costly recalls and reputational damage. Essential aspects of quality control include:
  • Selecting the right system
  • Defining instrument uncertainty: 
  • Choosing the right uncertainty


Measuring Instruments: Manual vs. Automatic

Measuring instruments can be categorized into manual, control benches, semi-automatic, and automatic systems. Automation enhances objective measurements and efficiency but requires programming and a higher investment.

Automatic instruments, especially optical measuring machines, are preferred for elastomers due to their non-contact measurement capabilities. They offer speed, ease of use, and accuracy, making them suitable for high-volume production environments.

Profile Projector (Manual)

  • Cost-effective and suitable for workshop use: This option is budget-friendly and ideal for basic workshop applications.
  • Lacks automation: Manual operation limits its efficiency and precision


Optical Coordinate Measuring Machine (O-CMM) (Automatic)

  • Accurate and complete: Offers high precision and comprehensive measurement capabilities.
  • More complex and slower: The complexity and slower operation may not be ideal for all production environments.


Large Field of View (L-FOV) Optical Measuring Machine (Automatic)

  • Fast and easy to use: Provides quick and user-friendly measurements.
  • Suitable for shop floor use: Balances precision and simplicity, making it ideal for production settings.
